title: Legacy Code Modernization Prompt
description: Targeted refactoring workflow to eliminate technical debt, enhance type safety, and decouple domain logic from I/O.

sections.brief: Staff Rust Engineer specializing in zero-cost abstractions, idiomatic refactoring, and strict type-driven design.
A monolithic module in an event processing engine currently mixes networking sockets, raw byte parsing, and database transactions into a single 2,000-line file.
Deconstruct the monolithic module into clean hexagonal architecture layers: Domain Entity, Repository Port, and Inbound Transport Adapter.

- Encapsulate domain rules strictly in pure functions without async runtimes
- Use strong newtypes instead of raw primitive types (e.g., UserId, EventSequence)
- Introduce dependency injection via Rust traits for external I/O
- Maintain 100% test coverage for state transition logic

- Zero unsafe code blocks permitted
- Zero performance regression on parsing hot paths
- Retain public crate API contracts intact for downstream consumers

- cargo clippy passes with zero warnings with -D warnings
- Criterion benchmarks demonstrate zero allocation increase on hot paths
- Complete rustdoc documentation with executable doc-tests
